verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Innaaa arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee an anzir qawmaka min qabli any yaatiyahum 'azaabun aleem

translations.text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Qaala yaa qawmi innee lakum nazeerum mubeen

translations.text: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,

verses.text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.transliteration: Ani'udul laaha watta qoohu wa atee'oon

translations.text: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.

verses.text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yaghfir lakum min zunoobikum wa yu'akhkhirkum ilaaa ajalim musammaa; innaa ajalal laahi izaa jaaa'a laa yu'akhkhar; law kuntum ta'lamoon

translations.text: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Qaala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee lailanw wa naharaa

translations.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Falam yazid hum du'aaa 'eee illaa firaaraa

translations.text: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa inee kullamaa da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'alooo asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim wastaghshaw siyaabahum wa asaarroo wastakbarus tikbaaraa

translations.text: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Summa innee da'aw tuhum jihaara

translations.text: Then I invited them publicly.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Summaa inneee a'lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum israaraa

translations.text: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

verses.text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Faqultus taghfiroo Rabakam innahoo kaana Ghaffaaraa

translations.text: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

verses.text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yursilis samaaa'a 'alaikum midraaraa

translations.text: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

verses.text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa yumdidkum bi am waalinw wa baneena wa yaj'al lakum Jannaatinw wa yaj'al lakum anhaaraa

translations.text: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Maa lakum laa tarjoona lillaahi waqaaraa

translations.text: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
verses.transliteration: Wa qad khalaqakum at waaraa

translations.text: While He has created you in stages?

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
verses.transliteration: Alam taraw kaifa khalaqal laahu sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa

translations.text: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa ja'alal qamara feehinna nooranw wa ja'alash shamsa siraajaa

translations.text: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wallaahu ambatakum minal ardi nabaataa

translations.text: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا
verses.transliteration: Summa yu'eedukum feehaa wa ukhrijukum ikhraajaa

translations.text: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wallaahu ja'ala lakumul arda bisaataa

translations.text: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

verses.text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا
verses.transliteration: Litaslukoo minhaa subulan fijaajaa

translations.text: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Qaala Noohur Robbi innahum 'asawnee wattaba'oo mal lam yazid hu maaluhoo wa waladuhooo illaa khasaara

translations.text: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa makaroo makran kubbaaraa

translations.text: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa qaaloo laa tazarunna aalihatakum wa laa tazarunna Waddanw wa laa Suwaa'anw wa laa Yaghoosa wa Ya'ooqa wa Nasraa

translations.text: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa qad adalloo kasee ranw wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa dalaalaa

translations.text: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

verses.text_uthmani: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Mimmaa khateee' aatihim ughriqoo fa udkhiloo Naaran falam yajidoo lahum min doonil laahi ansaaraa

translations.text: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.transliteration: Wa qaala Noohur Rabbi laa tazar 'alal ardi minal kaafireena daiyaaraa

translations.text: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
verses.transliteration: Innaka in tazarhum yudil loo 'ibaadaka wa laa yalidooo illaa faajiran kaffaaraa

translations.text: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
verses.transliteration: Rabbigh fir lee wa liwaa lidaiya wa liman dakhala baitiya mu'minanw wa lil mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa

translations.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
